about: Sourced hand corrections on top of the ČBK registry for Všech svatých / Dušičky 2026 — each from the parish's own 2026 announcement (ohlášky, bulletin, parish or diocese calendar), checked 2026-10-29. Format and how it is applied: data/corrections.mjs. Times not published by a parish are never invented here.
